answer:
The **Saturn V rocket** was used for the Apollo 11 mission, which landed the first humans on the moon in July 1969. This massive rocket, standing 111 meters (364 feet) tall, launched the Apollo 11 spacecraft from Cape Kennedy (now known as Kennedy Space Center) in Florida on July 16, 1969. 

The Saturn V carried the three Apollo 11 astronauts—Neil Armstrong, Michael Collins, and Buzz Aldrin—to the moon. It remained the most powerful operational rocket ever built and is still today the tallest and most powerful reusable launch vehicle ever developed. Neil Armstrong became the first human to walk on the lunar surface on July 20, 1969.
